privacy.metaDescription: How GK InterCare collects, uses and protects personal data.

hero.label: Legal
hero.title: Privacy
hero.description: This notice explains how GK InterCare processes personal data when you use our website and contact us.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: GK InterCare is a health tourism coordination service based in Istanbul, Türkiye.
For privacy questions, contact us at info@gkintercare.com.

sections.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: When you submit a contact, consultation, partner or callback form, we collect the details you provide such as your name, email, phone number, country and message.
If you use live chat after giving functional cookie consent, our chat provider may process conversation data and technical information such as browser details.
We do not currently use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or advertising trackers on this website.

sections.title: Why we use your data
paragraphs: We process form data to respond to your request, coordinate treatment enquiries and communicate with you about GK InterCare services.
The consent checkbox on each form is a separate permission for that specific request. It is not the same as cookie consent.
We use strictly necessary cookies to remember your cookie choice. Optional functional cookies are only used if you accept them.

sections.title: Legal bases
paragraphs: Depending on the situation, we rely on your consent, steps before a contract, legitimate interest in responding to enquiries, and legal obligations.
You may withdraw consent for optional cookies at any time through Cookie settings in the website footer.

sections.title: Retention and sharing
paragraphs: We keep enquiry records only as long as needed for coordination, follow-up and legal compliance.
Data may be shared with service providers that help us operate the website, email delivery and live chat. Providers are selected with appropriate safeguards.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict processing of your personal data, object to processing and request portability.
You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. In Türkiye, this may include the Personal Data Protection Authority (KVKK).

cookiePolicy.metaDescription: How GK InterCare uses cookies and similar technologies.

hero.label: Legal
hero.title: Cookie
hero.description: This page explains what cookies are used on gkintercare.com and how you can control them.

sections.title: What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. They help websites work, remember preferences and understand usage.

sections.title: How we use cookies
paragraphs: Necessary cookies store your cookie consent choice in a first-party cookie named gk_cookie_consent.
Functional cookies are only loaded if you accept them. They are used for Crisp live chat support.
Analytics and marketing cookies are listed for transparency but are not currently enabled on this website.

sections.title: Language preference
paragraphs: The website language is handled through the URL path (for example /en/, /es/, /it/). We do not use a separate language cookie for this feature.

sections.title: Managing cookies
paragraphs: When you first visit the site, you can Accept all cookies, Reject optional cookies or open Cookie preferences to choose categories individually.
You can reopen your choices at any time from Cookie settings in the footer.
You can also delete cookies through your browser settings.
